$meta.description: Teacher-facing recommended-action copy deck for the priority queue (Final Addendum §10, Todo 23.2). Each top-level key maps 1:1 to a trigger in priorityQueue.service.ts; the value carries one string per supported UI language. Strings render in the teacher's UI language (default English; per-teacher preference lands in Phase 19 alongside the other-language strings here).
$meta.authoring: Joey + ESOL practitioner co-author each English template. Translations are deferred to Phase 19 — the placeholder strings below are intentionally empty so a runtime fallback to `en` is unambiguous (empty string ⇒ untranslated ⇒ fall back).
$meta.fallback_rule: Renderers MUST fall back to `en` when the requested language slot is empty or missing. Never display a partial translation.

safeguarding_alert_unresolved.en: Safeguarding alert raised. Review and resolve within 24 hours.

dormant_active_learner.en: Learner inactive for 14+ days. Send a check-in message and schedule a contact session.

struggling_score.en: Three consecutive sessions below threshold. Review pathway and consider an anchor-mode adjustment.

inactive_7_13_days.en: Learner inactive for a week. Send an encouragement message.

vocab_retention_drop.en: Vocabulary retention dropped >20%. Schedule a reinforcement session.

stage3_stagnant.en: No progress on a Stage 3 objective for 21+ days. Discuss with learner and adjust if needed.

inactive_5_6_days.en: Learner inactive for several days. Light-touch nudge recommended.

low_average_score.en: Sustained low average score. Review last 5 sessions for patterns.

ready_for_progression.en: Learner meets all 5 progression criteria. Initiate level change.

healthy_maintenance.en: Learner on track. No action required this week.
